en.headline: Technical skills. No hype.
en.intro: A quick view of my working strengths, current limits and where I use AI. Select any skill to inspect how I work, what I would trust in production and the evidence behind it.
en.note: How I use AI: At work, I use AI as a tool for technical research, troubleshooting, dashboard drafts and iteratively developing automation from my requirements. I review the logic and make operational decisions myself; AI agents do not autonomously access or change production systems. I do not claim to write scripts independently from scratch. Fully autonomous AI-agent experiments belong exclusively to isolated machines in my private lab.
en.legend:
Rating

Visible 0–10 self-rating

Not a certification score. A range indicates uncertainty; early-stage, AI-guided skills are deliberately not rated.

Independence

What I actually rely on

Memory, documentation, search or AI. Generated output only counts after I understand and verify it.

Production

How cautious I would be

Independent, review-first, sandbox-first or lab-only depending on the technology.

editorial_practice.heading: Where I take responsibility
editorial_practice.description: Practical responsibilities in production IT. No lab ratings or claims of having designed every inherited system.
editorial_practice.lab_description: The expandable matrix below is a separate, subjective technical self-assessment. Proxmox, Kubernetes/Talos, Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, Flux/GitOps and NetBird are private lab experience; Linux and Docker are also part of my daily professional work.

items.title: VMware vSphere / ESXi
items.description: Maintain and troubleshoot the virtualization environment, including changes and updates. Independently plan fixes and keep recovery through Veeam in view.

items.title: Debian / Ubuntu Linux
items.description: The main server platform at work: bootstrap and document installations, harden SSH, handle cron jobs, system updates and administrative access.

items.title: Docker / Compose
items.description: Operate monitoring, ticketing, documentation and asset-management services. Adapt proven Compose templates and environment settings rather than claiming original image development.

items.title: Active Directory / Entra / M365
items.description: Administrate established identity and Windows infrastructure, troubleshoot login and policy issues, and maintain hybrid identity and Microsoft 365 services.

items.title: Omnissa Horizon / VDI
items.description: Helped build and now maintain the VDI environment, including Connection Servers, UAG, pools and image lifecycle tasks.

items.title: Veeam Backup & Recovery
items.description: Manage backups and regularly restore individual files; occasionally recover complete servers. Recovery experience, not just green backup-job dashboards.

items.title: FortiGate firewalls
items.description: Maintain the inherited configuration, create required firewall policies, investigate blocked traffic with policy lookup and perform updates.

items.title: PowerStore storage
items.description: Monitor thin provisioning and physical capacity, maintain the vSphere integration and carry out volume capacity changes for migrations.

items.title: AI-assisted IT tooling
items.description: Define automation requirements, inspect generated logic and iterate until it works. AI supports research and dashboard creation but never autonomously changes work production systems.
